title: RimWorld fully playable semantic UI surface
description: Host-side accessibility contract for playing RimWorld through a semantic UI surface. The native game remains authoritative for UI state, selection, legality, reservations, jobs, map state, and save lifecycle. Glue provides the renderer-neutral tree, stable locators, declared actions, focus order, and receipts.
playerActions: pause, resume, and change simulation speed
navigate the camera and select semantic map targets
inspect colonists, animals, items, buildings, blueprints, and incidents
assign work priorities and time assignments
draft, undraft, move, and prioritize a colonist
place, cancel, and prioritize a blueprint or designation
open, transfer, equip, consume, and drop inventory items
inspect health, assign treatment, and respond to medical rejection
inspect social/faction state and respond to dialogs or letters
draft combatants, choose a legal target, and issue a native combat job
open the world map, inspect a tile, and travel when native legality permits
save, load, recover, and resume the same semantic session
playableLoop: open the main menu through the semantic tree
start or load a deterministic colony and obtain a session/revision receipt
survey the current native UI and colony projection
select a colonist or target by stable semantic locator, never display name alone
inspect native facts and available actions
submit one declared action with the current snapshot and expected revision
allow RimWorld's native UI or JobGiver/WorkGiver to admit or reject it
read back the resulting UI state, native job state, and typed receipt
save and reload, then reconcile session, selection, and actor identity
continue through the same tree without hidden coordinate or host-only steps

surfaceContracts.nativeAuthority: RimWorld save/load dialogs and filesystem lifecycle
native map, pawn roster, and WindowStack
UIRoot camera controller and map bounds
Selector, InspectPane, Thing and Blueprint selection
WorkSettings, TimeAssignmentDef, JobTracker, and native work givers
Architect and Designator systems, reservations, reachability, and resource legality
ThingOwner, transfer dialogs, MassUtility, reservations, and reachability
HediffSet, HealthUtility, DoctorCareUtility, and medical JobGivers
ThoughtHandler, Pawn relations, Faction, LetterStack, and LordManager
drafting, targeter, combat JobGivers, reservations, reachability, and threat state
World, tile, caravan, faction, and route systems
RimWorld save/load lifecycle and native revision
WindowStack, FloatMenu, Dialog_MessageBox, and native targeters

successState: A player can enter, observe, select, act, receive native admission/readback, save, reload, and resume using only the semantic UI tree and declared controls.
failureState: Any missing native surface, stale locator, unavailable dialog, failed hook, or illegal action is exposed as a bounded typed receipt with no guessed target and no state drift.

firstProofCases.name: semantic-entry-and-load
firstProofCases.given: RimWorld is at the main menu
firstProofCases.when: the player surveys the tree and activates a declared load/new action
firstProofCases.then: the native dialog transition and resulting session are read back by semantic identity

firstProofCases.name: colony-observe-select-and-inspect
firstProofCases.when: the player surveys, selects a colonist by actor key, and inspects it
firstProofCases.then: native selection, actor observation, revision, and accessible state are read back

firstProofCases.name: native-action-and-rejection
firstProofCases.given: a colonist and legal/illegal target pair
firstProofCases.when: the player submits the same semantic action against both targets
firstProofCases.then: one native action is admitted and the other returns a typed rejection without state drift

firstProofCases.name: save-load-reconcile
firstProofCases.given: a colony with a selected colonist and pending observation
firstProofCases.when: the player saves, reloads, and resumes through the semantic tree
firstProofCases.then: session identity and native revision reconcile, stale locators are rejected, and focus returns semantically

evidencePolicy.hookPolicy: record not-fired and pending states; never silently drop a hook because it was not observed

semantic locator resolution for map/camera/selection targets

native dialog, FloatMenu, targeter, and keyboard event lowering
screen-reader output and focus behavior verification
fresh end-to-end proof across all listed gameplay surfaces
